units.horseshoe_reference_sets: v1 and v2, each split by whole run as below; never selected

frozen_from_R2: kernels, Nystrom basis (setup.npz), samplers, inspection grids, start laws, branched-pair operators (sigma.npz); nothing re-tuned

replica_split.nested: each 64-group is four consecutive 16-groups, each 16-group four consecutive 4-groups
replica_split.rule: contiguous halves of the 4096 saved replicas
replica_split.iid_justification: the 4096 replicas of a law are independent and identically distributed by construction: initial states are iid draws (torch.randint from the pool, or iid uniform for I2) and each step uses independent per-chain proposals and uniforms, so any outcome-independent index split gives iid halves; contiguous halves align with the 32 saved R2 groups of 128, so the evaluation half (groups 16..31) is checked against the saved full-ensemble summaries

spans.S3: V*_m(0): top-m eigenvectors of the static estimate O_0 (sigma.npz, t = 0); width^2 = lambda_{m+1}(O_{0,+}) (Section 3 baseline, r = 1/2)
spans.S4own: V*_m(t): top-m eigenvectors of O_t; width^2 = lambda_{m+1}(O_{t,+}) (Section 4)
spans.S4same: V*_m(0) at time t; width^2 = lambda_max(P_perp O_{t,+} P_perp), the compression of O_{t,+} onto the complement of V*_m(0) (Section 4 on the static span)
spans.no_observation: R sqrt(lambda_1(O_{t,+})) reported per t (no readings)

operator_margin.halfsplit: sensitivity plug-in: + ||O_A - O_B||/2 (eps_0 for S3, eps_t otherwise); a half-split proxy, not a bound

readings: empirical feature mean of each observation group minus the mean feature embedding of the reading NUTS runs; reading h = ||V^T (fbar_g - fbar_ref)|| in the 512-feature Nystrom representation (an RKHS-orthonormal basis of the landmark span)
plugin: P(R) = sqrt(h^2 + R^2 width^2): REFERENCE-BASED PLUG-IN AT AN ASSUMED RADIUS, FEATURE SPACE; never a confidence bound or a certified stopping rule
heldout: evaluation replicas (16 groups of 128) vs held-out runs: U-statistic MMD^2 (german_credit_r2.mmd2_jackknife), debiased feature ||delta||^2 and ||P_V delta||^2 (projection_jackknife), omitted-feature part MMD^2 - feature^2, unmonitored residuals; SEs by delete-one-group + delete-one-run jackknife; all signed, never clipped
heldout_status: ABOVE eps if est - 2.0 SE > eps^2, BELOW if est + 2.0 SE < eps^2, else UNRESOLVED (pointwise, not simultaneous over t; empirical, not a guarantee)

conventional_join.groups: the 16 observation groups of 4 with saved full paths (replicas 0..63) = R2 conv groups
conventional_join.window: second half (t/2, t] of each path (R2 conv_<law>.npz)

no_binomial_intervals: groups share one reference, operator and feature map: fractions over groups are descriptive only
shared_randomness: within a unit every group shares the Nystrom landmarks (calibration run), the operator estimates O_t (pool starts, stream r2-sigma), the reading reference runs and the held-out evaluation half and runs; groups of 4/16/64 are nested, paired and dependent; the observation groups are independent of each other only given these shared inputs
feature_space: readings, widths and plug-ins live in the 512-feature Nystrom space and address the feature discrepancy ||P_Z delta||; the full MMD adds an omitted-feature part for which no bound is supplied (reported separately as MMD^2 - feature^2)
checks: recomputed group_feat, group_pair_ksum, group_run_cross, group_coord_mean for all 32 groups at every t vs the saved R2 summaries (max rel 1e-10); full-ensemble MMD^2 (all runs) vs eval2
